privacy.note: No partner names, birth data, locations, or direct identifiers are stored.

reason: A relationship-level love-style label was too symmetric. The user clarified that one historical pair contains a stable actor/partner mismatch in romantic love that depends strongly on physical proximity.

context_interaction.distance: partner currently accepts a storge relationship from the user at a distance
context_interaction.physical_proximity: partner wants substantially more reciprocal romantic love when physically together, creating drama/pressure
context_interaction.interpretation: The relationship cannot be represented by one shared Eros/Storge score. Actor-specific romantic state and proximity moderation are required.

model_requirements_created_by_clarificat: Every love-style/RRF axis that can differ by person must permit actor-specific values.
Shared relationship-field variables must not substitute for actor-specific Eros, Storge, intimacy, or satisfaction.
Physical proximity/distance must be allowed to moderate mismatch consequences without changing the underlying actor-specific love state.
A model must distinguish accepting asymmetric love from actually sharing the same love style.
